COMPONENT_SUPPLY.rule: Six-key supply; trace basis belongs to supplying facts; each supplied component traced.

COUNTER_M.rule: Counter must be listed against leaf of evaluated TT and have lawful DIRECTIONAL counter-M trace.

CertifiedFact.rule: Bound source map supplies path/locators; verify bytes, digest, membership, case/side; extract proposition and require exact asserted-text match.

ORDER.rule: Admission before EV before DE-4; U-X before U-2 before U-3 before U-0/U-1.

PI-3.rule: Seven required identifying fields plus packageFactCount, packageSideCount, six identity locator labels, identityAuthority and identityAuthoritySha256 are equality assertions. No unknown members; no content/list locator authority.

W-1.rule: Exact registry census, each mechanism once; no duplicate entries.

W-2.rule: Witness identity equals every material record of f, not just subject.

W-3.rule: SELECTED has SUPPORTS_LEAF materialization covering all registry consumers; NOT_SELECTABLE has none.

W-4.rule: Every supply entry of every record of f is consistent with W(f,M), per component supplying facts; relation does not restrict scope.

corr6InvariantCoverage.FX05: S2 admission precedes DE-4 at S6

DE4.rule: B-1a applies to every admitted EVALUABLE direction before B-2

M-ACCESS-BY-LOYALTY-RELIABILITY.negative_cell: Not SFJ reciprocal-belonging loyalty semantics; not mere tenure; not formal role alone.

M-ADJ-ARGUMENT-QUALITY.negative_cell: Not that every decision follows the best argument; not consultation followed by rank decision.

M-ADV-REALISED-RESULT.negative_cell: Not a KPI threshold alone; not self-reported success; not one metric required.

M-AUTH-TECHNICAL-CREDIBILITY.negative_cell: Not hierarchy/status/prior agreement/proposer as the basis (that exclusion is the adjudication lane); not credentials alone.

M-AUTH-TOPDOWN-EXPLICIT.negative_cell: Not an org chart alone (FORMAL_ONLY); not mere existence of a hierarchy.

M-CAPABILITY-YIELDS-CONTROL.negative_cell: Not individual advancement (M-ADV-REALISED-RESULT lane); not mere possession of assets.

M-CONTINUITY-VIA-RELATIONS.negative_cell: Not a ritual; not static custom.

M-COST-MINIMISING-SURPLUS-RETENTION.negative_cell: Not profit alone; not generic efficiency programs; not inferred from low pay (E9/10 §8).

M-DECISIONS-SEEK-RELATIONAL-SAFETY.negative_cell: Not that harmony is always achieved; not a conservative-culture statement; not the POS trade-off alternatives.

M-EMPIRICAL-TEST-ITERATE.negative_cell: Not that the test decided a contested issue (C34 §7.4); not the immediate/continuous variant.

M-ENFORCE-RESOURCE-CONTROL.negative_cell: Not budget ownership alone; information control alone does not satisfy this leaf (that is M-ENFORCE-RESOURCE-INFORMATION-CONTROL).

M-ENFORCE-RESOURCE-INFORMATION-CONTROL.negative_cell: Not resources alone; not information alone.

M-ENFORCE-SANCTION.negative_cell: NOT routine/applied punishment required; not a written code only (FORMAL_ONLY fails).

M-EXTERNAL-ADAPTIVE-DEMAND.negative_cell: Not literal crisis; not "dynamic market" slogan.

M-IMMEDIATE-EMPIRICAL-ITERATION.negative_cell: Not a slow episodic test program; not a single experiment.

M-INFORMAL-LOYALTY-AUTHORITY.negative_cell: Not formal-title authority; not abstract-performance allocation; modal not hardened; NOT an unlabeled any-member set — the family reading is stated and source-justified, and the operative test is the contrast with abstract performance.

M-INQUIRY-OPERATION.negative_cell: Not an R&D budget line; not an academic label; not a mission claim.

M-INTERPRETIVE-CONTROL.negative_cell: Not ordinary policy ownership; not that participants comply.

M-MEANING-GOVERNED-COMPLIANCE.negative_cell: Not general obedience to managers; not compliance unrelated to the belief system; not inferred from co-occurrence — join applies.

M-MEMBERSHIP-ACQUIRED.negative_cell: Not deep trust; not hiring alone; not any one member of the list.

M-NO-EXTERNAL-ARBITER.negative_cell: NOT established by silence or absent documents (§J); not "no controls exist" generically; never inferred from result-following alone; a series of allocations that happened to follow test results is NOT proof of exclusivity; "we use tests" ≠ "tests are the sole arbiter".

M-OPEN-CRITICAL-EXCHANGE.negative_cell: Not a slogan of openness; not a single debate.

M-ORDER-SUSTAINED-FLEXIBILITY.negative_cell: NOT mere co-presence of order and discretion; NOT satisfiable by the three-layer coincidence alone; no causal counterfactual is claimed or detected; not flexibility despite the order.

M-PRES-ABSOLUTE-BELIEF.negative_cell: Not ordinary value statements; not that participants believe it; not "dogmatic" as evaluation.

M-PRES-APPLIED-EXPERIMENTATION.negative_cell: Not that tests decide issues or resources follow results.

M-PRES-BELONGING-CONTINUITY.negative_cell: Not any single label in isolation (bare "loyalty" or "care" alone insufficient); not network resource preservation (operative Ms); not trust gating.

M-PRES-DESIRE-FRAMING.negative_cell: Not that participation was actually activated by desire; not voluntariness; not retention architecture.

M-PRES-EXPRESSIVE-MEANING.negative_cell: Not authenticity; not emotional engagement; not that expression governs operation.

M-PRES-HIGHER-MISSION.negative_cell: Not that the mission is genuine, governs work, or is believed; not generic "mission statement" of commercial goals; NOT completion of the full accepted NF/NT Phenomenon (genuineness boundary, TT-NFNT-PH note).

M-PRES-INNOVATION-ACHIEVEMENT.negative_cell: Not that achievements exist or govern advancement.

M-PRES-STRICT-HIERARCHY.negative_cell: Not that enforcement operates; not dominance-based redistribution; tribute here is the displayed transfer/subordination practice, not operative extraction.

M-RECOGNISED-COMMAND-ORDER.negative_cell: Not formal bureaucracy; not chart only.

M-RES-ADAPTING-PERSON-RECRUITMENT.negative_cell: Not ordinary hiring alone; not retention of non-adapting personnel.

M-RES-ASYMMETRIC-RETENTION.negative_cell: Not nominal low pay alone (G-7); not a conclusion restated without a stated comparison basis (conclusion-only statements are INSUFFICIENT for c3); not a coder-chosen conversion unit; never established across incommensurable channels.

M-RES-CAPABILITY-ADVANTAGE.negative_cell: Not capex existence; not comfort spending; not secondary deployment.

M-RES-CONCEPTUAL-GENERATION.negative_cell: Not a budget line; not redistribution alone.

M-RES-EXPRESSIVE-EXPENDITURE.negative_cell: Not that expression is authentic; not uncontrolled.

M-RES-HIERARCHICAL-RETENTION.negative_cell: Not access control alone; not external redistribution.

M-RES-KNOWLEDGE-PRIMARY.negative_cell: NOT "other resources are spent on knowledge"; not an allocation-priority test alone; not incidental R&D; not application control; NOT an any-one-stage category (no single stage satisfies).

M-RES-NETWORK-AS-PRINCIPAL-RESOURCE.negative_cell: Not merely resources circulating inside a network; not the network as venue only.

M-RES-NETWORK-PRESERVATION.negative_cell: Not family ownership label alone; not the stronger principal-resource claim (that is M-RES-NETWORK-AS-PRINCIPAL-RESOURCE).

M-RES-NO-INTERNAL-REPLENISHMENT.negative_cell: NOT established by silence / absent documents (§J); not "wasteful"; Mode-D §21 record-class closure is not misapplied to ban this affirmative organizational negative.

M-RES-PROTECTED-ACCESS-EXCHANGE.negative_cell: Not ordinary employment; not unconditional access; not loyalty-only trust (that is the PW lane).

M-RES-REALLOC-BY-RESULT.negative_cell: NOT the absence of other arbiters — that distinct negative is M-NO-EXTERNAL-ARBITER (F03); not budget cycles by rank.

M-RES-ROLE-CONTROLLED-ACCESS.negative_cell: Not budget authority alone; not the retention/distribution end of the flow (M-RES-HIERARCHICAL-RETENTION).

M-RES-STAKE-UNPROVEN.negative_cell: Not moral greed; not large return; not fraud.

M-RES-TACTICAL-EXTERNAL-ACQUISITION.negative_cell: Not illegality; not ordinary sales; NOT satisfiable by an organization that primarily creates resources and only occasionally acquires externally; primary status never inferred from silence.

M-RES-UPWARD-TRANSFER.negative_cell: Not one transfer as criterion alone (E9/05 §12 applies at target level); money not required.

M-SACRED-UNITY-PERSISTENCE-FUNCTION.negative_cell: Not ordinary discipline; not risk disclosure; not motive invention; NOT satisfiable by consolidation/cohesion framing without the endpoint record; not any designation without consolidation framing.

M-THEORY-PRODUCTION.negative_cell: Not publication count as such; not applied product.

M-THREAT-AMPLIFICATION.negative_cell: Not ordinary risk disclosure; not that the threat is real or unreal; not motive.

M-TRUST-BY-DEMONSTRATED-LOYALTY.negative_cell: Reliability or professional competence alone does not satisfy; membership itself does not satisfy; not the STP/STJ loyalty/reliability gate (M-ACCESS-BY-LOYALTY-RELIABILITY).

M-ZERO-SUM-PRIMACY-CONTEST.negative_cell: Not a single competitive act; not market competition with outsiders.
